rule: R9 (refinement 20260910), as set by owner decision D4 (a) and DESIGN-POLISH M3 R21 / A-6 (2026-09-25): the modal FILED name verbatim — whitespace collapsed, case untouched, no TR->TRUST fold, no SEC-title substitution. (1) Group by the upper-cased, whitespace-collapsed form; drop pure-numeric, then <=3-char, then digit-leading groups whenever another group survives; the group with the highest summed weight wins, ties to the longer, then the codepoint-smallest form. (2) Inside that group the exact whitespace-collapsed spelling with the largest summed weight wins (the weights passed for it, or its occurrences when none are passed); ties to the codepoint-smallest spelling. An optional `weights` array is passed through by both runtimes' readers. Shared by tests/test_inst_agg.py and dashboard/test/format.test.ts.

cases.why: a tie inside the group goes to the codepoint-smallest spelling (capitals sort first)
the weighted sum decides the spelling: 5 against 2
an abbreviation is never re-cased (title-casing gave 'Asml Hldg Nv')
